title: GatePolicyConfig
description: Declarative CI/CD Continuous Authorization Gate Policy per ADR-0015 and INV-PRIME-007

evidence_tier.description: Hierarchical verification rigor: static_check (1) < test (2) < symbolic (3) < formal_kernel (4)

declaration_kind.description: Control satisfaction mechanism: 'implements' (authoritative code & evidence), 'requires' (dependency obligation without local evidence), 'inherited' (external CSP authorization boundary)

id.description: NIST SP 800-53 or custom control identifier

source.description: For kind=inherited, reference to [catalog.inheritance.<source>] in lean-rust.toml

attestation_expiry.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for inherited authorization attestation expiry

require_kani_pass.description: Require all Kani CBMC proof harnesses to pass

forbid_lean_sorry.description: Fail gate if any Lean 4 theorem relies on unproven 'sorry' axioms

min_control_coverage.description: Minimum fraction of controls whose evidence satisfies or exceeds required_tier (0.0 - 1.0)

min_default_tier.description: Default required evidence tier for controls that do not specify required_tier

coverage_basis.description: Basis for calculating coverage: 'unique_controls' counts distinct canonical control IDs; 'declared_controls' counts package-level declarations; 'baseline_catalog' counts in-scope catalog controls

waiver_mode.description: Semantics when waivers are present: 'downgrade' marks finding target as other and counts as tier-unsatisfied; 'risk_accepted' emits formal POA&M item and permits gate bypass; 'suppress' retains control in denominator, excludes from AR, and emits suppressed-findings.json

waived_controls.description: Explicit list of waived control identifiers

risk_accepted.description: Threshold caps and requirements for risk-accepted waivers

max_count.description: Maximum absolute count of risk-accepted controls allowed before gate fails

max_fraction.description: Maximum allowable fraction (0.0 - 1.0) of controls that can be waived as risk-accepted

requires_poam_milestone.description: Require explicit POA&M milestone and target date for risk-accepted items

mode.description: Promotion behavior on gate PASS: 'auto' promotes staging to release_dir and exits 0; 'manual' validates gate, retains staging without promoting, exits 0; 'never' forbids promotion, exits 2 if promotion attempted

staging_dir.description: Staging directory for unverified or rejected OSCAL artifacts

release_dir.description: Release directory where verified OSCAL artifacts are promoted on pass

profile.description: Catalog profile or scoping baseline, e.g. FedRAMP_Moderate, FedRAMP_High

inheritance.description: External platform and CSP leveraged authorizations per ADR-0005 §5.6

fail_on_stale.description: Exit with code 2 on E-OSCAL-015 evidence staleness

fail_on_drift.description: Exit with code 2 on E-OSCAL-014 catalog hash drift

fail_on_expired_attestation.description: Exit with code 2 on E-OSCAL-012 lapsed CSP inheritance attestation

fail_on_overdue.description: Exit with code 2 on overdue POA&M SLA items

require_poam.description: Require authoritative poam.json to exist; missing file triggers operational error exit 1

cat1.description: Severity levels mapping to Category 1 findings

cat2.description: Severity levels mapping to Category 2 findings

cat3.description: Severity levels mapping to Category 3 findings
